messages:
deploybot: Scheduled migration request: applying ADD INDEX ON users(email_verified) + streaming backfill tonight 2024-11-03 23:00-23:30 PT. Canaries: 2 shards at 23:05. Will acquire migration lease at 23:05. Please ack if you want to pin releases or add holdpoints.

Sam: ack. I want to pin service v3.4.1 before we start — last deploy showed a small serialization spike.

Lina: noted. can we set the backfill throttle to 50 rows/s per worker? last time 200/s caused replica lag.

Matt: rollback plan? if index apply blocks, what's the escape hatch?

Anika: rollback steps in short: 1) cancel backfill job 2) DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY if index partially created? (we avoid non-concurrent in prod) 3) revert schema pin (if we pinned) and start read-only fallback. full runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/migrations#email-index-backfill.

SRE-Oncall: monitor thresholds: replica_lag > 5s or p99_query_time increase > 20% trigger immediate stop. set alert channel #incidents and page. I'll be on pager at 23:00-00:00.

Diana: add a canary guard: deploybot run canary on tenant ids [1001,1002] for 5m then proceed. If canary fails, automatic hold.

Sam: also request a short quiet window for API writes during canary 23:05-23:12. Can we route 100% of writes to standby AZ for that period?

Lina: routing wise sounds heavy. instead we can feature-flag write path to degrade nonessential writes (events) for 10 minutes. I'll flip flag if we see >10% errors on canary.

deploybot: Canary: starting on shard-a tenant 1001 at 23:05. Command: `/deploybot run-migration --id mig-20241103-07 --canary-tenants 1001,1002 --throttle 50`

deploybot: Canary result: shard-a OK (5m), shard-b OK (5m). No replica_lag spike observed. Proceeding to roll wave 1 (10% tenants).

Matt: confirm: we pinned runtime to v3.4.1? if so, unpin plan?

Sam: pinned at 23:02. Unpin after final backfill completed and 1h stable.

Diana: rolling back if we hit lock > 2m on main table. escape hatch: `feature_flag:users_email_index_disabled = true` to stop read path that contends, and cancel backfill.

Anika: note for rollback: when canceling backfill, run quick sanity: `select count(*) from backfill_jobs where migration='mig-20241103-07' and status='running';` then `update backfill_jobs set status='cancelled' where id=...;` After cancel, wait 30s for leases to expire before dropping any partial index.

SRE-Oncall: I'll keep the histogram dashboard open + `pg_stat_activity` watch. If p99_tokenize > 200ms or any PG autovacuum backlog spikes, we stop.

Lina: small nit — set deploybot flag `--max-lock-wait=120s` so migration cancels early instead of hanging.

deploybot: Updated run command for rollout: `/deploybot run-migration --id mig-20241103-07 --throttle 50 --canary-tenants 1001,1002 --max-lock-wait 120s --pin-runtime v3.4.1`

Sam: thanks. I will be watching metrics and can unpin after 1h of stability.

Matt: good. if we need full rollback we follow Anika's runbook then cut a hotfix branch. I'll be ready to open PR.

Diana: leaving a quick checklist here: 1) canary pass ✅ 2) throttle 50 ✅ 3) pin runtime ✅ 4) SRE monitoring ✅ 5) rollback runbook linked ✅ 6) post-migration notes to release notes channel.

deploybot: Migration wave 1 started at 23:17. Will post updates.

Anika: FYI I'll be online for 30m after completion for verification.

SRE-Oncall: if anything weird, page me immediately. otherwise gl!
